new_categories.label: structural_boundary_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: In-service cargo-hold structural condition can be bounded to tank-top, bulkhead, ceiling or another hold boundary without retaining scantlings, member details or drawings.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_physical_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric physical-condition confidence state can represent a structural boundary without retaining thickness, corrosion values, deformation dimensions or acceptance limits.

new_categories.label: damage_defect_presence_confidence
new_categories.memory: Damage/defect confidence is distinct from measured severity and can be represented without retaining crack dimensions, corrosion extent, indentation size or structural calculations.

new_categories.label: localization_extent_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that a condition is localized or broader in scope can be represented separately from exact defect geometry or affected structural members.

new_categories.label: boundary_function_confidence
new_categories.memory: The structural boundary's in-service functional confidence is distinct from generic cleanliness, coating appearance or cargo-surface readiness.

new_categories.label: inspection_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Inspection/verification confidence is distinct from the physical boundary state and can degrade without retaining inspection methods, readings or acceptance criteria.

new_categories.label: independent_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent cross-check confidence can be represented separately from shipboard self-assessment and from the physical structural condition itself.

new_categories.label: temporary_restriction_confidence
new_categories.memory: A bounded restriction state can exist while structural-condition understanding or verification remains incomplete, without encoding loading or repair instructions.

new_categories.label: hold_availability_not_structural_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Hold availability or cargo-work permission is a downstream outcome and is not equivalent to the structural boundary's physical, defect or verification state.

new_categories.label: structural_condition_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: A hold structural-boundary condition can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-inspection, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction or isolation can attach separately to a boundary, hold/zone, defect-confidence state, inspection confidence or restoration-verification state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Inspection limitation, cargo-loading restriction, hold unavailability, repair/rework or schedule effects do not prove a tank-top, bulkhead, ceiling or specific defect root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_structural_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical correction, inspection, independent verification, restriction release and hold return-to-service can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: design_structure_vs_in_service_boundary_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P066 naval-architecture/structural design orientation does not duplicate bounded in-service cargo-hold structural-boundary condition assurance.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_surface_vs_structural_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P109 cleanliness, residue, dryness and surface-condition readiness do not establish the underlying structural boundary's in-service condition or defect confidence.

useful_refinements.label: internal_access_vs_structural_boundary
useful_refinements.memory: P112 ladders, platforms, gratings and access-support readiness are distinct from tank-top, bulkhead, ceiling or other hold-boundary condition.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_structural_condition_assurance
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered structural-condition assurance for a bounded cargo-hold boundary.

duplicates.label: generic_physical_condition_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic physical-condition, verification and independent-check mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact hold structural arrangements, scantlings, thicknesses, corrosion values, crack or deformation dimensions and current configuration
exact inspection readings, nondestructive-test details, acceptance criteria, structural calculations or class-rule thresholds
exact survey, cargo-loading, restriction, isolation, temporary repair, permanent repair, testing or emergency procedures
named inspectors, class or repair providers, ports, yards, incidents, deficiency findings or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact structural arrangements, scantlings, thickness, corrosion values, crack/deformation dimensions, member details and current configuration
exact inspection measurements, NDT methods, acceptance limits, structural calculations and rule thresholds
exact survey, cargo-loading, restriction, isolation, repair, testing, emergency or return-to-service procedures
named inspectors, class societies in a claim-specific role, repair contractors, ports, yards, incidents, findings, current readiness and private/regional/non-English lineages
stop_reason: The bounded structural-condition questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact member arrangements, thickness/corrosion/crack values, inspection criteria, structural calculations, cargo-loading/repair procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold in-service structural-boundary condition orientation and source-discovery output; not structural-survey, cargo-loading, repair or damage-response guidance and not proof of any exact arrangement, thickness, defect dimension, acceptance criterion, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
